title: Inside North Korea's Dynasty
description:
S01 E02 — The Son of God
The decline of Kim Il Sung and the rise of his son, Kim Jong Il; how Jong uses filmmaking and propaganda to gain power; the story of how Jong kidnaps South Korean filmmakers and wages a terror campaign in the buildup to the Seoul Olympics.

title: Inside North Korea's Dynasty
description:
S01 E03 — Nuclear Family
At the close of the Cold War, North Korea loses Soviet patronage; Kim Jong Il starts a nuclear weapons program; his government makes counterfeit money and sets up factories making crystal meth; he parties while the country struggles economically.

title: Inside North Korea's Dynasty
description:
S01 E04 — Rocket Man
Kim Jong-un takes power at the age of 28 and consolidates power by killing his uncle and half brother; the story of Jong-un's friendship with basketball player Dennis Rodman and a breakdown of Jong-un's historic 2018 summit with U.S. President Trump.

title: North Korea: Inside the Mind of a Dictator

title: North Korea: Inside the Mind of a Dictator

title: Drain the Oceans
description:
S02 E06 — Lost Nukes of the Cold War
Using computer-generated imagery, the Cold War's lost nuclear weapons are revealed on ocean floors, along with evidence of secret nuclear confrontations.

title: Drain the Oceans
description:

A high-tech expedition searches for the iconic wrecks of the Battle of the Pacific, including the USS Lexington and the USS Indianapolis; funded by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, the expedition explains some of the greatest WWII mysteries.

title: Drain the Oceans
description:

title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
description:
S01 E01 — Temujin: The Boy Who Will be Khan
Recounting the life of Chinggis Khan, beginning with the struggles of his early years, including his family's fall from power, his survival against rival tribes and his first alliances as a young warrior to rescue his kidnapped wife Borte.

title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
description:
S01 E02 — The Rise Of Chinggis Khan
Temujin's powers grow as he battles with Jamuqa; he is exiled, but he returns to unify the Mongol tribes when he takes the title of Chinggis Khan.

title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
description:
S01 E03 — The Birth of the Empire
Genghis Khan built power by building an army and eliminating rivals; he began conquests against the Tanguts and the Jin, expanding his empire.

title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
description:
S01 E04 — The Unstoppable Empire
When the neighboring empire attacks a Mongol caravan and Genghis Khan's envoys, he unleashes a campaign that annihilates the empire and solidifies Mongol dominance in Persia; he names his son Ogedei as his successor before his death.

title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
description:
S01 E05 — The Rule of Ogedei
Ogedei is proclaimed ruler of the Mongol Empire; he conquers Armenia, Georgia and the Jin Empire and builds the capital city of Karakorum.

title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
description:
S01 E06 — Europe Under Siege
Ogedei's death triggers a struggle for succession over the largest empire in the world.
